description: Architects Registration Board - The List of New Registration and Renewal of Registration of Chartered Architects, Architects and Architectural Licentiates for the year 2016/2017
categorisation: This gazette content pertains to the registration and renewal of registration for professionals (Chartered Architects, Architects, and Architectural Licentiates) for the year 2016/2017. It is published by the Architects Registration Board under the authority of the Sri Lanka Institute of Architects (Amendment) Act. This constitutes a commercial licensing and certification matter, as it involves the official registration of professionals who are eligible to practice architecture, which is a business/commercial activity. It does not involve government structure/personnel changes, land matters, legal frameworks, elections, public service, judicial matters, or other miscellaneous categories.
